title: tc-watchlist
description:
A watchlist of people, accounts or entities – avatar, name, reference, group and a risk badge – most at risk first,
with a count, filters by risk and a View all action.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

sort.description: "risk": most at risk first, then by name (default) · "name": by name · "none": as given

limit.description: Shows only the first this many rows; all when unset

filters.description: Shows the filter buttons: All and each risk that has rows, with counts

filter.description: The risk shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-filter-change listener calls preventDefault()

viewAll.description: The View all action's text in the header; empty for none

riskLabels.description: The risks' names, merged over the defaults (Critical, Elevated, Guarded, Low)

empty.description: Shown when there's nothing to watch

name.description: The person's, account's or entity's name

ref.description: A quiet reference under the name: an id, an account number

group.description: The case, team or list it belongs to, as a tag

avatar.description: A picture's URL; initials of the name otherwise

shape.description: Round for a person (default), square for an account or organisation
